title: BOOSEY & HAWKES CASED OBO
reason: Complete cased Boosey & Hawkes student oboe (bell stamp London / Regent, case plaque B&H Bandhite); used examples resell for about $150 to $300 if playable.
findings: Three-piece oboe (upper joint, lower joint and bell) with a black body and nickel plated keywork, in a grey hard case with red plush lining, with a spare reed in a clear tube and a blue pull-through swab. The case carries a metal plaque reading 'B&H BANDHITE' (a Boosey & Hawkes name, apparently for the student range). The bell has a gold stamp that I could read only in part: a crest, LONDON, and a last word that looks like REGENT, consistent with a Boosey & Hawkes Regent student oboe. No serial number legible. The Boosey & Hawkes attribution in the title is supported by the case plaque and bell stamp.
condition: Keywork looks dull with some tarnish, corks look intact, pads look serviceable but playing condition is unknown; no cracks seen in the black body; case scuffed.
rescore_note: Genuine Boosey & Hawkes Regent student oboe (case plaque and bell stamp seen), complete in its case with a spare reed; beginner grade with dull keywork and untested playing order, but working oboes are scarce; judged from photos and general knowledge only.
